comparison.objective: Route two cords through opposite cable-box slots, enclose the strip, and close the lid; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Cable routing, enclosure packing, and lid placement versus rigid precision tooling, bimanual striking, and small rigid-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Strip enclosed, one cord through each specified slot, no cord over the rim, lid flat, hands released versus four valid fractures with complete tang containment and intact hardware. Routing tolerances are unspecified.
comparison.reason: The central tested ability is deformable routing and closure, not controlled rigid-body fracture.
